name: SimplyBook.me
summary: Online booking and scheduling system for service businesses — booking website and widget, provider calendars, automated reminders and online payments.
best_for: service businesses that take appointments and want a booking page, reminders and online payment without building one
skip_if: you only need a simple calendar link for one person — a free scheduling link does that without a booking system on top
honest_knock: The plan ladder is set by bookings per month and by how many custom features you may switch on, and those two ceilings move independently — so you can outgrow a plan on features while nowhere near the booking cap, or the reverse. Free and Basic also carry SimplyBook.me branding on your booking page; white-label starts at Premium.

pricing.notes: (2026, re-read 2026-09-20 on their own pricing page; the euro ladder below was verified there on 2026-09-11 and has since stopped being shown to us) Free EUR 0: 50 bookings a month, 1 custom feature, 1 provider, no card needed. Basic EUR 11.90/month billed annually or EUR 13.90 monthly: 100 bookings, 3 custom features, 5 providers. Standard EUR 24.90 annual or EUR 29.90 monthly: 500 bookings, 8 custom features, 15 providers. Premium EUR 49.90 annual or EUR 59.90 monthly: 2,000 bookings, unlimited custom features, 30 providers. Enterprise is quote-only. Annual billing saves a stated 17%. Their own page says no setup fees, no transaction fees and no per-user charges — payment processors bill their own rates separately. A 14-day trial of premium features runs without a card. CURRENCY CHANGE, 2026-09-20: simplybook.me/en/pricing now serves the ladder in Brazilian reais, not euros — R$0, R$33.75, R$65.83 and R$110 a month billed annually, and R$0, R$40.5, R$79 and R$132 billed monthly, with priceCurrency 'BRL' in the page's own schema.org markup. The same reais appear on /de/, /fr/, /pt/, /es/ and /nl/pricing, read the same day, and the page carries a language switcher but no currency switcher, so a visitor cannot ask for another currency. SECOND READING, SAME DAY, DIFFERENT COUNTRY: a server in Frankfurt (German IP, Accept-Language en-GB) was served the identical ladder, R$0 / R$33.75 / R$65.83 / R$110 billed annually, with priceCurrency BRL five times in the page markup. Two independent European networks in two countries were both quoted reais on 2026-09-20, so the currency does not track the visitor's location within Europe and this reads as a fault or a global default on their side rather than a regional price. The euro amounts above are therefore the last figures we could read in euros and not necessarily what a European buyer is quoted today; check the currency on the card before comparing. Everything structural is unchanged from 2026-09-11: the booking caps (50/100/500/2,000), the premium custom feature counts (1/3/8/unlimited), the providers (1/5/15/30), the 17% annual saving, the 14-day no-card trial and the no-transaction-fee, no-per-user-charge promise.
